lessons.title: LLMs: What AI Actually Is
lessons.summary: Five short stations show how Gemini and ChatGPT read your words, guess the next one, forget things and sometimes make things up. Then crack a real AI case with your group and finish with a 10-question quiz.

stations.title: Token Counter
stations.summary: See how AI chops your words into tokens, in English and Chinese.

stations.title: Next-Word Predictor
stations.summary: Guess the next word, then see what the model would pick and why.

stations.title: Memory Bucket
stations.summary: Watch a chat fill up until the AI forgets your first message.

stations.title: Training & Model Size
stations.summary: How much does an AI read before it can chat? More than you think.

stations.title: Real or Made Up?
stations.summary: Spot the hallucination before it fools you.

stations.title: AI Case Detective
stations.summary: Group mission: crack a real case where AI went wrong, name the cause and give one rule to stop it.

stations.title: LLM Quiz
stations.summary: 10 questions. See your score and every answer explained.
